name: pike-arcade
summary:
plan.md is written. Along Pike Place (east, +x) the building climbs from a low green-posted North Arcade shed (y 19) through a 2-storey block to a 3-storey white-brick Main Arcade over a red/white-awninged stall shed, all on a grey stone Down Under that drops west to the bay with window tiers by ground level.
It peaks in a flat-roofed corner block at Pike Street (z 280..311) carrying the red-neon PUBLIC MARKET CENTER sign (red glass over glowstone, east face, y 48..69), a two-faced red-ringed clock, MEET THE PRODUCER and the fish ice beds: the market's postcard view.
Not tested: I didn't run the roof tool's dry-run on any roof, and I placed the sign letters and the clock by hand on paper, so their fit still needs a render. All block ids pass the toolkit's block check and exist in 1.21.1. White quartz-brick Main Arcade over a stone Down Under base, with a green-post stall arcade along the east street face and the open North Arcade shed to the north. The hero is the south-east corner: red neon PUBLIC MARKET CENTER sign, round neon clock, MEET THE PRODUCER board and the fish ice beds. Dusk glow comes from froglight behind the panes, hung lanterns in every bay and glowstone behind the red glass letters. (7 of 7 parts finished)
